Method of Attack: Using stolen NVIDIA code-signing certificates to sign malware and drivers to appear legitimate and bypass Windows security
Malware signed includes remote access trojans (Quasar RAT), Cobalt Strike beacons, Mimikatz, backdoors
Indicators of Compromise: Stolen NVIDIA code-signing certificate serial numbers: 43BB437D609866286DD839E1D00309F5, 14781bc862e8dc503a559346f5dcc518
Samples uploaded to VirusTotal signed with stolen certificates
